_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). Pure-C# utility mod with no card JSON, so modules follow the code's responsibilities (Nexus client, update checking, discovery, suite installer, installed-mod scan, conflict diagnostics, window). Localization CSVs feed the generated MumText.Table.cs and name no card, so their rows attribute to the mod-wide module. `module_map.py check Mod_Update_Manager` must exit 0.

modules.name: Nexus Client
modules.summary: Requests to Nexus Mods: the API and public clients, public query model, request headers, API key check, response cache policy and endorsement.

modules.name: Update Checking
modules.summary: UpdateChecker, UpdateScheduler, the window-open policy, the public check plan, version comparison, the version ledger, changelog parsing and the compatibility chip.

modules.name: Mod Discovery
modules.summary: Finding mods on Nexus: NexusModDiscovery, the New and updated feed, the built-in known-mod registry and folder-to-Nexus mod mappings.

modules.name: Suite Installer
modules.summary: The embedded mod suite: ZIP reading, extraction and install (with the keep-previous half), batch apply, suite dependencies, descriptions, registry, version reader, installed-elsewhere check and the handoff note.

modules.name: Installed Mods and Profiles
modules.summary: ModScanner and the InstalledModInfo row, plugin metadata reading, saved profiles, the My Mods sort orders and the comparison view.

modules.name: Conflicts and Load Diagnostics
modules.summary: ConflictDetector, missing-dependency validation, plugin GUID collisions, and the loaded-status probe comparing BepInEx and framework load against installed folders.

modules.name: Window, Text and Settings
modules.summary: The IMGUI UpdateManagerUI window, MumText and its generated English table, player preferences and the BepInEx config.

modules.name: Mod-wide
modules.summary: Plugin entry, GameLoadPatch, the shared log sink and JSON helpers (MumLog, JsonText, SimpleJson), project files and docs.
